name: Does AKN Design Group build new custom homes?

mainEntity.name: Does AKN Design Group build new custom homes?

acceptedAnswer.text: AKN Design Group specializes in comprehensive residential renovations, including whole-home remodels, substantial additions, and high-end outdoor living spaces, rather than ground-up new home construction. Our expertise lies in transforming and enhancing existing homes within the Dallas–Fort Worth metroplex, offering a managed design-build process for significant projects. We focus on integrating new spaces and updated designs seamlessly into your current home's structure and aesthetic.
acceptedAnswer.description: AKN Design Group specializes in comprehensive residential renovations and additions, not ground-up new home construction.
